title: Make pi-search the sole complete web stack
description: Replace the prior Pi web-search runtime with pi-search as the only production owner. Resolve the audit findings, inventory prior workflows against our actual needs, implement required coverage, run offline and credential-gated acceptance, and cut over only when no required capability is missing.

logs.msg: Workflow inventory and contract hardening are complete; remaining gate is live/Pi acceptance and final single-owner cutover.
